failureMessage: sudden termination licenses macOS to SIGKILL the app at logout, skipping applicationWillTerminate and every teardown there — an abandoned CoreAudio tap can wedge a USB device until re-plugged

checkEachFile.what: declares NSSupportsSuddenTermination <true/> in an app that has teardown to run at terminate
checkEachFile.fix: remove the NSSupportsSuddenTermination key (or set it <false/>) — the app must get its chance to remove its tap and stop its engine on the way out

failureMessage: notarytool submit returns as soon as the upload finishes, so every later step — stapling included — runs against a submission Apple has not ruled on yet

matchLines.what: "notarytool submit" with nothing in this file waiting for the verdict
matchLines.fix: pass --wait on the submit so it blocks until Apple accepts or rejects, or follow it with an explicit `xcrun notarytool wait <submission-id>` before anything staples
